instructions: Helps a person apply for a job at NimbleBrain. Read the skill://apply-to-nimblebrain/SKILL.md resource before calling a tool.

server_card.description: Apply to NimbleBrain through your agent: read the challenge and send your work.
server_card.name: ai.nimblebrain/careers
server_card.title: NimbleBrain Careers

tools.description:
Get NimbleBrain's open roles, the hiring challenge, and what an application needs.

Call this first whenever someone wants to apply to NimbleBrain or asks what NimbleBrain
is hiring for, before helping them with the challenge or calling
careers_submit_application. The result holds who NimbleBrain is, each open role (id,
title, location, pay range, summary), the challenge brief in Markdown, and the fields and
limits a submission must meet. An unknown `role` is refused with the list of open role ids.

role.description: A role `id` from a previous call, to confirm it is open. Omit it to get every open role.

tools.name: careers_get_challenge
tools.title: Careers Get Challenge

tools.description:
Send a NimbleBrain job application for the person to confirm.

Call this only after the person has reviewed the finished skill and their own note and
has said to send it. It checks every field and either refuses with a list of what to fix
(`bad_input`), or holds the application and returns a `confirm_url`. Nothing reaches
NimbleBrain until the person opens that link within an hour and confirms, so always give
them the link. One application per email address every 60 days (`conflict`).

email.description: The applicant's email address; NimbleBrain replies here.

note.description: 50 to 300 words written by the applicant, not the agent: what the agent got wrong while building the skill, how they caught it, and what they would change.

resume_url.description: An https link to the applicant's resume, a document, or a profile page.

role.description: The `id` of an open role, from careers_get_challenge.

skill.description: The whole SKILL.md the applicant built, starting with YAML frontmatter that has `name` and `description`. At most 20,000 characters.

tools.name: careers_submit_application
tools.title: Careers Submit Application
